metadata.value: FALCON is an open-source software collection for real-time analysis of radio resources in private or commercial LTE/LTE-A networks. It decodes the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) of a base station and reveals the number of currently active devices including their Radio Network Temporary Identifiers (RNTIs) and their individual resource allocations.
